baseline.existingCompiler: relations.ts expands explicit requirement-obligation pairs; prerequisiteIds are analysis dependencies, not source control flow.
baseline.existingValidator: relation-result.ts checks same-obligation coverage and fact pointers; it does not establish semantic applicability.
baseline.existingRender: render.ts D already requests an entry-to-effect causal chain; B and plain/v4 remain standard.

observedQuestionGaps.distinction: Source file ownership checks a file, while caller-selected collection receives the write; identifying a control alone does not bind it to the effect target.
observedQuestionGaps.existingSupport: resource-binding already asks to keep a checked other resource distinct; focused paired question makes the two objects and operation explicit.

observedQuestionGaps.distinction: A caller/helper write gate protects the destination before the sink; a sink-local missing check is insufficient to conclude bypass.
observedQuestionGaps.existingSupport: entry-control, authorization-decision and effect-reachability cover the pieces, but their question order does not force an explicit path-applicability comparison.

decision: Add an optional pure, obligation-local reasoning plan with questions only. Reuse existing facts and citations; no new task schema, relation graph, wire version, host semantic truth or source-derived answer fields.
standard: No additional questions, prompt section, or changed default behavior.
sharedMarkdownAndDslIntervention: The identical rendered questions are available to both independent Markdown and authoring/v2 arms; the MD manifest remains identity-only and supplies no hidden answer.
